purpose: Non-selection diagnostics for determining whether any v8 interaction increment is distributed, causally aligned and genuinely state-dependent rather than a few-row or coefficient-redistribution artifact.
prediction_identity: Use only the exact fixed holdout predictions from the formal v8 run; no refit, reselection, thresholding or state-variable substitution.

fixed_prediction_concentration: positive and negative contribution row counts
top1/top5/top10 shares of positive SSE gain
remaining total fixed-prediction SSE improvement after removing top1/top5/top10 positive-gain rows without refitting
incremental_information: correlation between a50_ordinary_x_rvol20 and formal V6 fixed residual
correlation between the raw interaction and target
correlation between raw interaction and its two main effects
time_shift_placebo: same-row correlation between interaction_t and gap_t
lead-one-row correlation between interaction_t and gap_t_plus_1
lag-one-row correlation between interaction_t and gap_t_minus_1
mechanism_continuity: report ordinary and holiday formal subsets exactly as produced by the formal run
do not create a high/low rvol20 threshold from holdout outcomes

interpretation_rules.positive_formal_increment_and_positive_i: supports incremental continuous-state pass-through but is still consumed-holdout evidence
interpretation_rules.formal_increment_without_residual_relati: treat as coefficient-geometry caveat; no model edits authorized
interpretation_rules.high_concentration: retain as concentration caveat; do not remove events
interpretation_rules.lead_or_lag_comparable_to_same_row: alignment concern requiring clock/data audit only, not feature tuning
interpretation_rules.coefficient_sign: diagnostic only; no directional sign gate

forbidden: derive a volatility cutoff from results
replace rvol20 with another state variable
change the primary v8 progression verdict from non-gate diagnostics
